description: Default attack skill granted by equipping a weapon of a given class. This relationship is NOT in RePoE source (base nodes carry skillsGranted: [] and item_classes.json has no default-skill field) — it is a hand-authored game fact. The map is the irreducible rule (default-skill gem metadata key -> class slug, or an array of slugs when one default attack serves several classes); the builder expands it into a derived `default_skill` edge from every base in each class to the gem, so new bases from a re-scrape pick it up automatically. 2H weapons inherit the 1H default attack (only the animation differs).

_deferred.note: Intentionally unmapped pending confirmation of PoE2 mechanics — do not guess. Add to `map` once verified.

cases.staff / sceptre / wand / focus: Caster/off-hand weapons — unclear if they grant a weapon default attack.
cases.SkillGemPlayerDefaultGrenadeLauncher: Grants 'Grenade' but there is no grenade-launcher base class to attach it to.
